candidate.title: CytoSeq
candidate.scope: The assigned Illumina CytoSeq (gene expression cytometry) schematic: poly(A)-mRNA capture on cell- and molecular-barcoded beads in microwells, bead pooling, pooled cDNA synthesis/amplification and sequencing. The single-cell RNA inset and oligo legend describe the target and capture component, not extra preparation branches. The card title and matching collection-page caption identify one target; the catalogue list of similar methods, kit suggestions and related reviews adds no target workflow. This is a schematic-level architecture, not a complete implementation or a claim of transcriptome-wide coverage.

states.label: Cell suspension
features: Intact single cells are the starting biological units; their mRNAs are the biological target.
The left inset shows a single cell pointing to RNA labeled AA(A)n, identifying a poly(A)-tailed target. It is an explanatory inset, not a separately routed RNA-isolation workflow.

states.label: Each bead with unique oligos
features: Bead-attached capture oligonucleotides have the depicted segments Universal, Cell label, Molecular index and Oligo dT.
The legend places Universal next to the bead and Oligo dT at the distal end; it supplies no explicit 5′/3′ end labels.
Cell and molecular barcode information is carried by the capture probes. The different colored bead cartoons illustrate distinct bead identities; they do not depict alternative methods.

Abstract, sentences 1–2
evidence.quote: We present a technically simple approach for gene expression cytometry combining next-generation sequencing with stochastic barcoding of single cells. A combinatorial library of beads bearing cell- and molecular-barcoding capture probes is used to uniquely label transcripts and reconstruct the digital gene expression profile of thousands of individual cells in a single experiment without the need for robotics or automation.

This is pooling of capture beads, rather than pooling intact cell-containing microwells.

features: The rightmost source label is Barcoded mRNA from single cells. In this architecture it denotes the RNA represented by the sequenced cDNA-derived library, rather than a separately depicted direct-RNA sequencing reaction.

operations.label: Cell lysis, mRNAs hybridize on bead
operations.description: Lyse the co-confined cell and hybridize released mRNAs to bead-bound capture oligos, changing intracellular RNA into bead-associated RNA within the well.
operations.mechanism: The diagram depicts lysis followed by hybridization; its poly(A) RNA inset and Oligo dT segment identify the complementary capture interface.
operations.information_effect: Transfers the cellular RNA substrate onto labeled capture probes while spatial confinement associates captured transcripts with the local bead. Covalent cDNA synthesis occurs in the later depicted block.
